title: Fire and rescue authorities, May 2021 (England and Wales, generalised, clipped)
description: The 47 fire and rescue authority areas of England and Wales.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Fire_and_Rescue_Authorities_May_2021_EW_BGC_2022" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Fire_and_Rescue_Authorities_May_2021_EW_BGC_2022/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 47 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
